about.title: About
about.name: Eng/Nouran El-Masry
about.bio: I am an MEP engineer who transforms architectural plans into living systems that work silently inside buildings — HVAC that breathes, precisely calculated water networks, and efficiently distributed power.
about.bioExtra: I start by understanding how every space is used before drawing a single line, then build the 3D model and resolve clashes with other disciplines early, so drawings arrive at site ready and clear.
about.bioFinal: My belief is that good engineering is invisible, but felt by everyone who enters the space.
